fieldValues.title: Errors point agents the wrong way
fieldValues.statement: When a create call fails, the message can describe a cause that is not the real one, leaving the agent unable to tell what input is allowed. Inconsistent create contracts across entity kinds add to the guessing.
source_ref: srs-context:record create: misleading error when instanceId is supplied
srs-context:view/composition create require $schema; field/type create do not
